861:t_048:6.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Now, one of the good boys and girls playing Super Robot Wars, 'Super Robot Wars Fan' from Aichi Prefecture...」

861:t_048:7.en:
$$カズミ$$
「Sent us a postcard asking, 'What is the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ that was introduced in this game?'」

861:t_048:8.en:
$$カズミ$$
「$$タカヤ$$, what do you know about the $$Ｚクリスタル$$?」

861:t_048:9.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「It's a system that activates $$次元力|lc$$ to affect the whole force. You can also upgrade it in various ways with $$Ｚチップ$$s!」

861:t_048:10.en:
$$カズミ$$
「You're close. That's not all the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ does. Its power will become clear as you progress through the game.」

861:t_049:7.en:
$$レイ#pt394$$
「Does playing with someone else make you happy?」

861:t_049:9.en:
$$レイ#pt394$$
「Would someone be happy if you played for them...?」

861:t_050:3.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Hey, how can I get better at playing?」

861:t_050:4.en:
$$カヲル$$
「You just need to practice. Play the same stage over and over.」

861:t_050:5.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Until your levels and funds let you play comfortably. That's the only way.」

861:t_050:6.en:
$$カヲル$$
「But for now, I think you should rest first.」

861:t_050:7.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Huh... But I was just getting the hang of it...」

861:t_050:8.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Don't look so sad. You can start again anytime, $$シンジ$$.」

861:t_050:9.en:
$$カヲル$$
「As long as you players want the world to keep going. Until then, we must part for a little while.」

861:t_050:10.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Good night, $$カヲル$$. And good night to all you players, too.」

861:t_051:3.en:
$$シンジ$$
「For the first time in ages, I had fun playing Super Robot Wars with you like this, $$カヲル$$.」

861:t_051:4.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Neither have I, $$シンジ$$. I'd like to play with you again.」

861:t_051:5.en:
$$シンジ$$
「But... are you really okay with this? You're just watching me play, $$カヲル$$.」

861:t_051:6.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Super Robot Wars is a single-player game, after all. But just watching is plenty of fun, too.」

861:t_051:8.en:
$$カヲル$$
「After all, I was born to meet you.」

861:t_052:3.en:
$$シンジ$$
「$$綾波$$, if you're free, do you want to play Super Robot Wars with me?」

861:t_052:4.en:
$$アヤナミレイ$$
「If that's an order, I'll do it.」

861:t_052:5.en:
$$シンジ$$
「No, it's not an order, but...」

861:t_052:7.en:
$$アヤナミレイ$$
「What would $$アヤナミレイ$$ do at a time like this?」

861:t_052:8.en:
$$シンジ$$
「What do... you want to do?」

861:t_053:3.en:
$$アスカ$$
「What? You're stopping the game here!? It's just about to get good!」

861:t_053:5.en:
$$マリ$$
「Sorry! I haven't had enough sleep, so I'm off first. I'm counting on you to keep the player company all by yourself, Princess~!」

861:t_053:7.en:
$$アスカ$$
「W-well, I guess it can't be helped! You can take a break, but you have to come back!」

861:t_053:8.en:
$$アスカ$$
「You got that!? It's a promise!」

861:t_053:9.en:
$$マリ$$
「...You're still as bad as ever at saying what you feel, nya~.」

861:t_054:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I see, you're stopping here... I had hoped to enjoy 'Super Robot Wars' with you a little longer...」

861:t_054:4.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Heh... Does hearing me say that put you on the spot?」

861:t_054:5.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「But even I have nights when I want someone by my side.」

861:t_054:6.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I hope I can fight alongside you someday.」

861:t_054:7.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Then we shall meet again, mighty players.」

861:t_055:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Stopping here is a good decision. Fatigue leads to careless mistakes.」

861:t_055:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I'd like you to resume after a good rest, but first, I have a word of advice.」

861:t_055:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「In Tag Battle, the basis of this game's combat, the key is teamwork between the two units on a team.」

861:t_055:6.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Find a comrade... or a rival you can truly trust, and help each other grow stronger.」

861:t_055:7.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I'll be waiting for you to return on the battlefield.」

861:t_056:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Stopping here is a good decision. Fatigue leads to careless mistakes.」

861:t_056:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I'd like you to resume after a good rest, but first, let me tell you something useful.」

861:t_056:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Something happens when a pilot who's become an ace enters $$Ｄトレーダー$$...」

861:t_056:6.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Find out the answer by playing for yourself. Until we meet again.」

861:t_057:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Hey, $$バナージ$$. Are you enjoying 'Super Robot Wars'?」

861:t_057:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Well, about that... I just can't seem to use the $$ユニコーン$$'s Destroy Mode properly...」

861:t_057:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
「How do I get the $$ユニコーン$$'s horn... to split open...?」

861:t_057:6.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If you want tips on splitting something over your head, ask $$シン$$ or $$キラ$$.」

861:t_057:8.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Who knows...? You'll understand once you're a little more used to the game.」

861:t_058:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「I hate to admit the mistakes I made because of my own youth...」

861:t_058:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「The man who once said that grew up and changed as time went by.」

861:t_058:5.en:
$$シャア$$
「But there are also things that never change, no matter how the times change.」

861:t_058:6.en:
$$シャア$$
「They are Super Robot Wars... and the passion of its players...」

861:t_058:7.en:
$$シャア$$
「I, too, believe that people with that passion will protect Earth.」

861:t_059:3.en:
$$クェス$$
「Why are you stopping just when things are getting started!? Keep playing!」

861:t_059:4.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Don't be unreasonable, $$クェス$$. It's bad for your health if you don't get proper rest.」

861:t_059:6.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「My folks are always on my case about it. They say there's no point if you make yourself sick, right?」

861:t_059:7.en:
$$クェス$$
「Oh, that's one way to look at it... Yeah, maybe you're right!」

861:t_059:8.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Then let's say goodbye. Let's say, 'See you!'」

861:t_059:9.en:
$$クェス$$
「Make sure you come back, okay? You have to!」

861:t_060:3.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
「The save is complete. Shall we... quit the game, Captain?」

861:t_060:4.en:
$$オットー$$
「I'll leave that decision to the player. We will stand by so we're ready for any decision.」

861:t_060:5.en:
$$オットー$$
「The fighting will continue. This is only a brief rest, after all.」
